title: Since Update 2.8.1.1 history is empty
symptom: Since updating to version 2.8.1.1, the history tab is totally empty regardless of the selected date. The issue is observed in both original and modified AAPS versions, and also in later versions like 2.8.2.
evidence_quote: Like the title says, since update to 2.8.1.1 the history is totally empty. Doesn't matter how date I select nothings gets loaded.
